---
title: "Video Game Duration"
---

Browse completion times from HowLongToBeat across thousands of video games. Use the search bar to find any game or sort by playtime.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)
library(DT)

# Load data and add decade groupings
games <- read_csv("howlongtobeat.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(!is.na(main_story_hours), !is.na(completionist_hours)) |>
  mutate(Decade = if_else(!is.na(release_year) & release_year >= 1980, paste0(10 * (release_year %/% 10), "s"), "Other"))

# Interactive searchable table of video games
games |>
  select(
    Game = game_name,
    Year = release_year,
    Decade,
    `Main Story (hrs)` = main_story_hours,
    `Completionist (hrs)` = completionist_hours,
    `Review Score` = review_score
  ) |>
  datatable(
    options = list(
      pageLength = 15,
      autoWidth = TRUE
    ),
    rownames = FALSE
  )
```
